correctness.rationale: The analytic proof checks exact normalization beta=k(n-k)/[n(n-1)] and omission p0, decomposes the entire (n-1)-dimensional first-harmonic coefficient space into invariant dimensions t-1, q-1, 1, and obtains each compression eigenvalue from conditional one/two-coordinate inclusion probabilities. For the mixed sector the omitted value is -kt. Each eigenvalue is strictly positive for t>=3, 2<=k<=q; exact subtraction factors as -p0(n-1)[n-(t+1)k]/[(q-1)(n-k)]. Eigenvalue ordering gives the least singular value and sharp inverse norm. Limits use explicit finite products. The separate standard-library checker directly builds Gram forms and passes all 165 exact-rational parameter triples through n=13, testing all sectors, cross terms, positivity and phase comparisons. These finite checks corroborate but do not substitute for the general proof.

value.rationale: First-degree Johnson harmonics and coordinate-star union masks are canonical finite-dimensional spectral and sampling objects. A complete sharp spectrum supplies injectivity, optimal reconstruction condition numbers, all least-singular directions and a nontrivial finite integer phase transition. The t-1 perfectly localized modes coexist with a change between q-1 outside modes and a one-dimensional mixed bottleneck. This is a natural infinite-family exact operator invariant; no arbitrary computational slice, textbook rephrasing or unsupported downstream theorem is used as motivation.
